articles.title: Farage’s Reform UK gets $97M from two crypto billionaires
articles.snippet: Ben Delo, co-founder of BitMEX, donated almost $50 million to Nigel Farage’s Reform UK party, matched a day later by Christopher Harborne.

articles.title: Crypto Billionaires Hand Reform UK $97M in Record Donations
articles.snippet: Ben Delo and Christopher Harborne each gave £36 million, and between them beat what every UK party raised last year.
